articles.title: Strategy opens door to selling billions of bitcoin under new capital plan. Here's what it means
articles.snippet: The company can now sell bitcoin to fund the USD reserve, support preferred dividends, and finance up to $2 billion in stock buybacks.

articles.title: Saylor's Strategy initiates buybacks and bitcoin monetization program, lifts STRC dividend
articles.snippet: Strategy adopted a new capital management framework, authorizing up to $2 billion in buybacks while creating a program that allows future bitcoin sales to support liquidity.

articles.title: Tether's USDT jumps to 8.5% premium in India after crypto payment crackdown
articles.snippet: Raids on crypto payment firms in Bengaluru disrupted the pipeline that feeds dollar-pegged USDT to Indian platforms, pushing its local price more than 8.5% above the dollar, roughly double the usual gap.

articles.title: Bitcoin hovers below $60,000 as crypto braces for a pivotal week
articles.snippet: BTC added 0.6% to $59,800 to start the week while SOL rose 2%, though derivatives data and chart formations point to continued downside risk.

articles.title: Strategy unveils capital framework to preserve Bitcoin exposure, pay dividends
articles.snippet: Michael Saylor’s Strategy unveiled a capital framework allowing Bitcoin sales to fund dividends, a $2.55 billion reserve and buybacks while raising STRC payout to 12%.
